title.en: Claude Sonnet 5.5: Faster, Lower-Cost Everyday Work

text.zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 主打速度与任务成本
text.en: Claude Sonnet 5.5 targets speed and task cost

text.zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，称其是 Claude 5.5 系列的第二款模型。相较 Sonnet 5，它生成速度提升超过30%，多数工作任务的成本最高可降低30%。标价与前代相同：每百万输入词元2美元、输出词元10美元，缓存读取词元0.20美元；节省主要来自完成相同工作的词元更少。
text.en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. The company says it generates outputs more than 30% faster than Sonnet 5 and can cost up to 30% less per task for most work. Token prices are unchanged: $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output tokens, and $0.20 per million cache-read tokens. The claimed task savings come from using fewer tokens to do comparable work.

text.zh: 官方资料将它定位为处理范围明确的日常工作：修复代码问题、制作文档、演示文稿和表格。公布的评测显示，Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分从 Sonnet 5 的10.3%升至70.6%；在知识工作评测 GDPval-AA 上，它的成绩也接近 Opus 5.5。Anthropic 还称该模型在图像理解、长周期任务和计算机操作方面有所增强。
text.en: Anthropic positions the model for well-scoped, everyday work: fixing bugs and producing documents, slides, and spreadsheets. In the company’s published results, its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score rises to 70.6%, compared with 10.3% for Sonnet 5. On the GDPval-AA knowledge-work evaluation, its result is close to Opus 5.5. Anthropic also reports gains in image understanding, long-horizon tasks, and computer use.

text.zh: 基准进步不等于复杂判断能力相同
text.en: Benchmark gains do not erase the judgment gap

text.zh: 这些数字来自 Anthropic 的评测与测试，不能单独说明模型在所有真实工作中的表现。公司明确表示，面对复杂、开放且需要持续判断的任务，Opus 5.5 仍明显更强；Sonnet 5.5 更适合作为较快、较省的补充。外部测试者的反馈也主要是早期体验，不应视为对所有用户和工作流程的保证。
text.en: These figures come from Anthropic’s evaluations and tests; they cannot establish how the model will perform across all real-world work. The company explicitly says Opus 5.5 remains clearly stronger on complex, open-ended tasks requiring sustained judgment. Sonnet 5.5 is framed as a faster, lower-cost complement, not a universal replacement. Feedback from early testers is useful context, but it is not a guarantee of results for every user or workflow.

text.zh: 安全方面，Anthropic 表示，由于其网络安全能力接近 Opus 5，Sonnet 5.5 首次配备面向高风险网络安全请求的防护与回退机制；生物学相关防护沿用 Sonnet 5。公司称这些措施针对范围较窄的高风险请求，日常软件开发和多数生命科学工作不受影响。对实际采用者而言，仍值得在目标工作流中验证质量、响应速度与真实成本。
text.en: On safety, Anthropic says Sonnet 5.5 receives cyber safeguards and fallbacks similar to those used for its most capable models because its cybersecurity abilities are comparable to Opus 5. Its biology safeguards are unchanged from Sonnet 5. The company says these protections target a narrow set of high-risk requests and do not affect routine software development or most life-sciences work. For adopters, quality, latency, and actual task costs still need to be checked in the workflows they intend to use.
